blurb: Guests can enjoy daily lunch with live music, gourmet Latin and international dining with nightly live shows, and a vibrant nightclub atmosphere with DJs and dancers. The venue offers salsa lessons with mojitos and party bites, followed by nightclub access until 5am. Private and semi-private event spaces are available for celebrations and corporate events.
